title: The feasibility of delivering and evaluating stratified care integrated with telehealth (‘Rapid Stratified Telehealth’) for patients with low back pain: a feasibility and pilot randomised controlled trial
comparison_or_design: The randomized Rapid Stratified Telehealth pilot comparison.
observations_or_assays: Waiting time from randomization to first rheumatologist appointment
time_scope: Waiting time to the first appointment; baseline to month 3 for pain and RMDQ.
excluded: Other visits, appointment counts, other feasibility outcomes and PROMIS domains
population_or_material: The randomized pilot trial groups, retaining the actual denominator used for appointment waiting-time summaries.
requested_items: Reported waiting-time medians/IQR and explicit qualitative waiting-time comparison; baseline/month-three observed pain/RMDQ medians/IQR with actual assessed denominators. Do not calculate missing contrasts or significance.
